style.styleTitle: Homcom Set of 3 3ft+4ft+5ft Pre-Lit Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a snowy forest vibe indoors or outdoors with this 3-piece pre-lit pencil Christmas tree set (90/120/150 cm). Displayed together or separately, they feature realistic PE foliage (65/100/150 tips) dusted with snow flocking. Pre-lit with warm white LEDs, the flocked Christmas tree set offers 8 lighting modes via an IP44 waterproof battery box. Built with pet-friendly, flame-retardant materials and stable fabric-wrapped cement bases, these artificial pencil trees are great for small spaces. . The 3-piece Christmas tree set includes small (90 cm), medium (120 cm) and large (150 cm) trees for versatile arrangements; . The PE foliage provides shape retention, realistic appearance and long-lasting use; . The pre-lit flocked Christmas trees are paired with 50/80/150 warm white LED lights for a cosy holiday display; . 8 dynamic lighting functions supported by batteries (not included), creating a warm holiday atmosphere; . IP44 waterproof rating ensures safe use both indoors and outdoors on porches or patios; . Made with pet-friendly and fire-retardant materials for safety around pets and family; . The slim pencil trees with small base diameters fit perfectly in compact rooms, apartments, dorms, or entryways; . Sectioned design with weighted fabric-wrapped cement base ensures reliable stability and convenient setup (taking 30–45 minutes); . Colour: Green, White; . Light Colour: Warm White; . Material: PE, Steel, Cement, Fabric; . Overall Dimensions: Small: F45 x 90H cm, Medium: F58 x 120H cm, Large: F73 x 150H cm; . Base Dimensions: Small: F8 x 5H cm, Medium: F12 x 5H cm, Large: F15 x 5H cm; . Tip Count: 65/100/150; . LED Light Count: 50/80/150; . Power Supply: Battery Operated (Requires 3 x AA batteries per tree, not included); . Item Label: 83C-291V80GN; . Shaping Note: In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get possible look.
